target.title: fix(fal): image generation hangs on slow generated-image downloads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where fal image generation could hang while downloading the generated image when fal storage or CDN served bytes very slowly. The generated image response already had a size cap, but the download request itself had no timeout, so a slow drip response could keep the image generation workflow open indefinitely.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fal generated image download now uses the same bounded HTTP timeout as the fal video download path. This keeps the fix scoped to generated image asset downloads and does not change fal generation request timeouts, media size limits, provider auth, or SSRF policy behavior.

## User Impact

Users running fal image generation can expect stalled generated-image downloads to fail instead of hanging the workflow forever, while normal downloads still use the existing media size cap.

## Evidence

- Verified that the fal image provider now passes a timeout into the generated image download request:

  ```text
  $ node scripts/test-extension.mjs fal
  [test-extension] Running 3 test files for fal
  The `envFile` option is deprecated, please use `envDir: false` instead.
  
   RUN  v4.1.9 [local path redacted]
  
  
   Test Files  3 passed (3)
        Tests  65 passed (65)
     Start at  02:09:52
     Duration  56.16s (transform 89.92s, setup 3.12s, import 107.87s, tests 441ms, environment 0ms)
  ```

- Verified the guarded download path times out a slow local drip response instead of waiting for the size cap:

  ```text
  [fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 200ms (elapsed 878ms) operation=fetchWithSsrFGuard url=http://127.0.0.1:44727/files/generated.png
  {
    "elapsedMs": 1382,
    "message": "request timed out"
  }
  ```
